thread:
ops-bot: Pager: quality_regression detected for model `redwood-qa-3b` in region us-east-1. Error rate (low-confidence hallucinations) up 18% vs baseline. Trigger: eval suite 'prod-smoke-v2' failed.

Maria Chen: I'm on pager. Pulling logs and recent deploys now. @Sanjay can you grab routing control?

Sanjay Patel: on it. First question — is this across all customer traffic or a subset? I'm checking routing metrics.

Maria Chen: Looks like traffic spikes to `redwood-qa-3b` started at 11:02 UTC after the canary promoted `redwood-qa-3b-v2`. Canary was 5% traffic, then auto-promoted. Failures jump at ~11:05.

Ravi Kumar: timeline matches. Canary health checks passed (latency ok) but quality evals show entropy drop and hallucination heuristics increase. Likely a model regression, not infra.

Sanjay Patel: Proposed immediate mitigation: route prod traffic for the affected service to the previously pinned model `redwood-qa-3b-v1` or fallback `redwood-3b-stable`. Which do we prefer? v1 has closer schema but slower. Fallback is slightly cheaper and tested in stress.

Alice Nguyen: For customer impact, we need a short status page entry ASAP and a targeted customer note for any customers who used the model-specific endpoint. Draft below — please iterate quickly.

Alice Nguyen (draft status page):
- Impact: Users of model `redwood-qa-3b` may experience degraded output quality (increased hallucinations).
- Scope: ~5% traffic during canary window; mitigation in progress.
- Current status: We have rolled traffic to a stable model variant and are monitoring.
- Next update: in 30 minutes or earlier.

Jules (CS): I'll prep a customer-facing message for partners on the `model-specific` plan. Draft: "We identified a regression in outputs from model 'redwood-qa-3b' after a recent promotion. We've routed traffic to a stable model and are actively investigating. No action needed on your side; we'll follow up with details and root cause." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: That reads well. Add ETA for full rollback investigation: "targeted rollback complete, monitoring for 1hr".

Sanjay Patel: I'm going to pin traffic to `redwood-3b-stable` now. Command I will run:```bash
# route production default model to fallback
redwood routing update --service app-prod --default-model redwood-3b-stable --note "auto-failover: quality regression"
```

infra-bot: Received request to update route for service app-prod. Executing change in us-east-1. Change ID: ch_1912004327_01.

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Handoff: @Maria Chen remains on investigation, @Sanjay running mitigation. Page owner: Maria.

Maria Chen: Running quick A/B on a sample prompt set against v1 vs stable to confirm behavior. Will paste diffs.

Maria Chen: Sample diffs show stable > v2 on hallucination heuristics. Good. Rolling forward with the pinned change.

infra-bot: Route update succeeded: default-model for app-prod -> redwood-3b-stable. ch_1912004327_01 closed.

Sanjay Patel: Confirming traffic shift completed (5m window). Percent to fallback now ~98% for endpoints that used redwood-qa-3b. Error rate back to baseline.

Jules (CS): Sending customer note now to the affected distribution. Using Alice's draft + ETA. Copy: "We routed your requests to a stable model variant as a precaution. We will send a follow-up once the investigation completes. Contact support if you see issues."

Alice Nguyen: Posting status page update now. Template used, short and measurable.

Maria Chen: Quick internal note for follow-ups: do not re-promote `redwood-qa-3b-v2` until we finish root cause analysis. Candidate actions: revert canary, run extended eval suite, add regen prompt tests to CI.

Ravi Kumar: I'll spin an isolated job to run the full eval harness against v2 to capture failing prompts and seeds. Command:```bash
run-evals --model redwood-qa-3b-v2 --suite prod-smoke-v2 --output /tmp/regression-1912004327.json
```

Maria Chen: Good. Also create a temporary pin so customer traffic stays away:```bash
# pin to stable for 24h
redwood models pin --service app-prod --model redwood-3b-stable --expires 24h --reason "quality regression auto-pin"
```

infra-bot: Model pin created: pin_1912004327_01. Expires in 24h.

Sanjay Patel: One-off rollback command (if needed):```bash
redwood deploy rollback --service app-prod --to-version redwood-qa-3b-v1
```

Maria Chen: Logging next steps: (1) block re-promotions for 24h, (2) run full eval on v2, (3) prepare post-incident summary and customer follow-up, (4) add regression tests to canary suite. Assigning owners: Ravi -> evals, Alice -> status + comms, Jules -> customer follow-up, SRE (Sanjay) -> routing/pin.

Jules (CS): Notifying top 5 impacted customers directly via email. Will share copy in #customer-notifications channel.

Alice Nguyen: We'll do an update at +30m and then a final at +2h with root cause if available.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. For the record: incident mitigated, traffic rerouted, monitoring green. We'll keep this thread for follow-ups and the postmortem draft.

ops-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated. Please file postmortem with summary and timeline.

Ravi Kumar: I'll attach eval outputs and failing prompt examples to the postmortem.

Maria Chen: Closing handoff: on-call until 1912005400 UTC, will hand to next on-call if no regressions.

Sanjay Patel: Noted. Good job all. :shipit:
